# PDF.js

Vendored from the legacy/compatibility build of pdfjs-dist 6.4.299. Apache-2.0; see LICENSE.
Both the library and worker use this build for Safari compatibility; Chrome uses the same files.
Regenerate with npm ci && npm run vendor:pdf. No external runtime requests are needed.

Compatibility: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/wiki/Frequently-Asked-Questions#legacy-build
